excluded_inputs: Family 001 features, models, predictions, decisions and outcomes
Family 002 tensors, labels, models, ONNX files, predictions, decisions and outcomes
Family 003 pair fits, residuals, decisions, baskets and outcomes
Family 004 M15 features, virtual outcomes, online state, scores, decisions, trades and outcomes
V1-V8 signals, opportunity timestamps, component labels, state and economics
material_distinctions: completed M1 within-bar body, wick, true-range, volume and spread sequence rather than H1 or M15 return state
joint regression of four directly executable actual-cost utilities rather than direction class, barrier probability or adaptive expert score
quarterly expanding-window recurrent fits rather than one full-window model or online outcome memory
one selected single-symbol action rather than residual or cross-sectional paired execution
no clock, weekday or session feature

decision_geometry.decision_epoch: every exact quarter-hour common M1 opening epoch
decision_geometry.required_input_epochs: t-61 through t-1 inclusive for both symbols
decision_geometry.required_label_epochs: t through t+14 inclusive for both symbols
decision_geometry.normal_trading_day: server date with at least sixty complete decision windows
decision_geometry.lifecycle_start_count: one accepted single-symbol action counts once

feature_tensor.per_fit_standardization: training rows only mean and population standard deviation per feature; standard deviation floor 1e-8

action_utility_labels.entry: Bid open at M1 t; long pays recorded t Ask spread and short enters Bid
action_utility_labels.prior_atr: simple mean true range over completed M1 t-60 through t-1
action_utility_labels.stop: one prior ATR adverse from direction-specific entry price
action_utility_labels.take: 1.5 prior ATR favorable from direction-specific entry price
action_utility_labels.maximum_hold: fifteen M1 bars t through t+14, then direction-specific close
action_utility_labels.same_bar_stop_and_take: adverse stop wins and exact threshold execution is used
action_utility_labels.short_intrabar_ask: Bid high/low plus that M1 row's recorded spread
action_utility_labels.maturity: a label may enter a training fit only after all fifteen potential future M1 bars complete

model.architecture: single-layer GRU, last hidden state, Linear32, GELU, Linear4
model.loss: Huber over all four action utilities
model.fit_rule: one expanding fit per quarterly test block using every eligible initial/development label matured strictly before the block start
model.locked_fit_rule: only after one development role passes, one final unchanged-procedure fit uses labels matured before 2026-01-01 and is frozen before locked inference

candidate_bundle.ranking: highest finite predicted action utility above role threshold, then frozen action order

risk_volume_and_execution.volume_rounding: floor two-percent one-ATR risk volume to 0.01; use 0.01 below minimum only when planned loss is at most four percent of current actual balance
risk_volume_and_execution.actual_execution: the same direction-specific path as the corresponding action-utility label
risk_volume_and_execution.stressed_cost: subtract the same observed direction-specific round-trip spread burden once again
risk_volume_and_execution.capacity_after_early_exit: wait until the next complete quarter-hour decision

python_training_owns: eight deterministic expanding development fits and conditional final locked fit
offline prediction tape and fixed action ranking
ea_must_own: exact M1 completeness, tensor order and ONNX schedule validation
symbol contract, tick size, tick value, lot and market-state validation
current-balance risk sizing and fail-closed order submission
protective stop, take and fifteen-M1 close
restart recovery, ownership, persistence and bounded evidence

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net

ordered_stages: declaration before source copies, tensors, labels, fits, ONNX or candidate economics
byte-equal source materialization and complete trainer implementation freeze with timestamp/tensor/fit geometry and dummy ONNX parity only
one complete eight-fit 2024-2025 three-role development process
locked 2026 final fit and confirmation for at most one unchanged complete passer
self-contained EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.no_development_passer: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5 without an adjacent feature, model, seed, epoch, threshold, action, risk or exit rescue
stop_rules.environment_or_engineering_fault: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires a separate user-authorized engineering and handoff decision
